desc:
Locked in a cell with your friends? Punch your way out!

🆕 UPDATE: CHAPTER 2 - THE YARD! Escape Chapter 1 once to unlock it, dig up the buried crate and carry it to the gate.
🎃 HALLOWEEN: pumpkin gloves, candy shop and spooky skins until Nov 2!

👊 Break the prison walls cube by cube in first person, with 13 different hole shapes
💰 Sell the rubble at the crusher and buy upgrades: harder punches, bigger holes, a bigger backpack and helpers
🐦 New yard helpers: pigeons, Biscuit the dog, tower hoses and a bulldozer
🤝 Team up with up to 5 players: team upgrades help everyone, and a Roblox friend gives +10% gems
🔦 Find the hidden tunnel and break out together on Easy, Normal or Hard
💎 Earn gems for every escape and unlock gloves, hit effects, classes and emotes
💪 Train at THE GYM for permanent upgrades
🏆 Hall of Fame: fastest times for both chapters, most escapes, blocks and playtime
💡 Vote for the best ideas on the IDEAS board

Use code RELEASE for free gems!
